description: This file defines a specific exception class 'BadProviderConfigException' used in Orleans for handling errors related to misconfigurations of storage providers for grains.

classes.name: BadProviderConfigException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating a bad or missing storage provider configuration for a grain, derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: BadProviderConfigException()
methods.description: Default constructor for the exception class.

methods.name: BadProviderConfigException(string msg)
methods.description: Constructor allowing an error message to be specified.

methods.name: BadProviderConfigException(string msg, Exception exc)
methods.description: Constructor allowing both an error message and an inner exception to be specified.
